title: A Table, Unclaimed
lessons: a third place can be yours without a transaction

text: The corner table's empty. Everyone else assumes it's somebody's.
Fine. It's mine now. Me, a book, and an hour nobody's asked me for.
Around me, everyone's very busy looking busy. I could do that too.

choices.text: Read until the room goes away.
Close the book. Watch people without making up their lives.

text: Chapter ends. Nothing buzzes to tell me good job.
Cups. Coats. Someone's terrible posture. Rain starting on the window.
That's the whole room. It's enough.
